description: Computes the substitute tax and INPS contributions of the Italian regime forfettario (flat-rate scheme) from turnover. With `ateco` or `coefficiente`: the exact calculation, with deadlines and advance payments. With `ricavi` only: a TABLE with the calculation for each statutory profitability coefficient (`modalita: 'tabella_per_coefficiente'`, field `scenari`), because the coefficient depends on the activity and has no default. Field `soglia_ricavi` states whether the regime applies (`fascia`: entro_limite = within €85,000; uscita_anno_successivo = above €85,000 up to €100,000, valid this year, exit next year; uscita_immediata = above €100,000, the regime ceases this year and `calcolo_valido_anno_corrente` is false: the amounts do not apply). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

ateco.description: ATECO code from which the profitability coefficient is derived. ALTERNATIVE to `coefficiente`. With neither, the response is the per-coefficient table, not the exact calculation.

codice_ateco.description: Alias of `ateco` (ATECO activity code): the same value, accepted because other tools of this server use this name. If you send both names, the values must match.

coefficiente.description: Profitability coefficient in % (manual override). ALTERNATIVE to `ateco`. With neither, the response is the per-coefficient table.

contributi_cassa_privata.description: Private professional fund contributions already paid, in euro (optional).

gestione_inps.description: INPS pension scheme or professional fund (optional).

startup.description: Reduced 5% rate for new businesses: applies to the starting year and the following four (default false → 15%). It does not change the advance payments: none are due in the first year of activity, and the response notes say so.

name: calc_forfettario
title: Regime Forfettario calculator
